propertySets.name: Pset_MobileTelecommunicationsApplianceTypeAccessPoint
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of  IfcMobileTelecommunicationsAppliance and types of IfcMobileTelecommunicationsApplianceType with the predefined type set to ACCESSPOINT.

properties.name: BandWidth
properties.definition: Indicates the bandwidth for telecommunication of the device.

properties.name: DataEncryptionType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of security protocols that can be used in the access point to protect the wireless network.

properties.name: DataExchangeRate
properties.definition: Indicates the data transfer rate of the access point in bit per second (bps).

properties.name: NumberOfAntennas
properties.definition: Indicates the number of antennas integrated in the device.

properties.name: NumberOfInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.

properties.name: UserCapacity
properties.definition: Indicates the user capacity of the device, defined as the maximum number of users that can be active at the same time.
